definitions.explanation: The act of deliberately seeking out faults, mistakes, or weaknesses in someone or something. Carries a negative connotation — the person doing it is seen as petty or unfair. Composed of 粗 (coarse, flaw) + 探し (searching).

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗探|あらさが}し⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧な。
examples.english: Stop always looking for faults in others.

examples.japanese: {粗探|あらさが}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗探|あらさが}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{嫌|きら}われている→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧。
examples.english: He is disliked because he is always looking for faults in other people.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with a negative connotation. The person doing {粗探|あらさが}し is seen as petty. Often appears with ⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧ (always/only doing) to emphasize the habit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粗探|あらさが}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to look for faults)
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗探|あらさが}し (fault-finding in others)
- {粗探|あらさが}し⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do nothing but nitpick)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{難癖|なんくせ}→難癖：15237_nankuse⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ means to find fault or make complaints, but implies fabricated or unreasonable criticism. {粗探|あらさが}し implies searching for real flaws.
